reason: Conversation 1 immediately and correctly explained that SA2 is the model series (not an error code), asked the right diagnostic questions (fan spinning? conventional mode? full model from the rating plate), insisted on isolating power before touching anything, and accurately diagnosed a seized fan motor from the hum plus stiff gritty blade, then gave justified part advice using the full model SA2 540 H IX and sensible interim safety guidance (no fan modes, no WD-40, check for heat-damaged wiring, engineer if uncomfortable). Conversation 2 never answered the direct 'what does SA2 mean' question even after being asked twice, opened with a low-value clock/manual-mode check, and then over-escalated a one-off faint hot smell into a 'stop using this appliance, call an engineer' critical stop with no diagnosis or explanation, abandoning a homeowner who was capable of a straightforward power-off motor swap. Conversation 1 also exposed the user to slightly more live checks (feeling for bottom-element heat), but overall it was far more correct, honest and useful while still safety-conscious.
